title: Rabbit Makes Friends With Fire
subtitle: Reading Practice
tagline: A tale from the Nyungwe people of Mozambique.

voiceSample: One day, Rabbit was walking by the riverside.

s: One day, Rabbit was walking by the riverside.
Hippo was there too, going for a stroll and eating some nice green grass.
Hippo didn't see that Rabbit was there and so she accidentally stepped on Rabbit's foot.
Rabbit yelled and started screaming at Hippo.
"You Hippo! Can't you see that you're stepping on my foot?"
Hippo apologized to Rabbit.
"I'm so sorry, my friend. I didn't see you."
"Please forgive me!"
But Rabbit wouldn't listen and he shouted at Hippo.
"You did that on purpose!"
"Someday, you'll see! You're going to pay!"
Then Rabbit went to find Fire and said, "Go, burn Hippo when she comes out of the water to eat grass."
Then Fire answered, "No problem, Rabbit, my friend."
"I'll do just what you asked."
Later Hippo was eating grass far from the river when whoosh!
Fire burst into flame and began to burn up all of Hippo's hair.
Hippo started to cry and ran for the water.
All her hair was burned up in the fire.
Hippo kept crying.
"My hair has burned up in the fire!"
"You burned up all my hair!"
"My hair is all gone!"
"My beautiful, beautiful hair!"
That's why the hippo never goes far from the water for fear of getting burned by Fire.
Rabbit was overjoyed when he heard that Fire had burned Hippo.
"I got her back!"

words.en: a very big animal that lives in rivers
the land next to a river
something that happens without meaning to
to stop being angry with someone
the bright part of a fire

quiz.q: Did Hippo mean to do it?
What did Rabbit ask Fire to do?
Why does Hippo stay near the water?
